overview: Ingrid is a tricky zoner who likes to pester opponents around the mid-range with an array of projectiles while building up Sun Crests from afar. With enough resources, Ingrid can deal absurd damage from across the screen, but has to be careful not to be too predictable against defiant opponents.

At the mid-range, Ingrid has a fundamental zoning game. Sun Shot is a projectile that pauses briefly before traveling forward that can also be held to alter its timing against parry-happy opponents. The Light and Medium versions both shoot forward with the only difference being their initial velocity and distance before pausing, while the Heavy version shoots upward at an angle before descending. Ingrid also has Light Rising Sun as a typical anti-air with an atypical quarter-circle motion. If she has the Drive Gauge, Ingrid can combine the meterless horizontal Sun Shots with an OD angled Sun Shot and vice versa to fill the screen with obstacles. At closer ranges, Ingrid has some solid pokes to complement her Sun Shots, like 5HK's long range, 2HP's special cancels, 5HP's whiff punishes, and 4MK's target combo extensions. When she does get a hit, Rising Sun serves as her primary combo ender, with the Medium version working off lights and the Heavy version being much slower but offering a variety of follow up afterwards.

Once the opponent is far enough away, Ingrid can use Light Sun Flare to gain a Sun Crest, a buff that enhances her zoning and Super Arts to even greater heights. Ingrid can stock up to four Sun Crests at a time, and can choose between Medium Sun Flare to keep the opponent far away from Ingrid and continue stocking up, or spend up to two Crests for Heavy Sun Flare to cash out on her resources with a devastating full-screen beam. Furthermore, OD Sun Flare stacks with Sun Crests, with a 2-stock OD Sun Flare piercing across the screen as an anti-fireball, a combo extender, a long-range whiff punish, and a pressure tool all wrapped up in one. She can also perform Solar Burst, a downward-angled air variant that can snipe opponents from afar or extend from Halo Flight for a terrifying low crush.

If the opponent gets frustrated and starts trying to chase her down, Ingrid has a few extra options to take them by surprise. Vanishing Sun lets Ingrid teleport either forward with a point-black dropkick, downward with an overhead hip attack that ground bounces, or backwards to escape full-screen to get back to zoning. While they all are on the slower side, they work well in conjunction with Sun Flare, tacking on some extra damage and repositioning her up close for pressure. Finally, Sun Veil has Ingrid hold up her beloved Monoid to take a hit, sending the opponent back mid-screen if successful. While somewhat slow on its own and vulnerable to throws, OD Sun Veil removes those weaknesses entirely, giving her an invincible reversal to further frustrate the opponent.

Along with Drive Gauge and Sun Crests, Ingrid's also got some remarkable, albeit atypical Super Arts to further manage. Her Level 1 Super Art Shining Sun is a flip kick that works as a reversal, anti-air, and combo ender alike. It can be enhanced with Sun Crests to further increase its damage to a whopping 2700 for massive reward. Ingrid's Level 2 Super Art Order of the Sun summons three shooting stars to fall on the opponent, landing either in front of, on top of, or behind the opponent depending on the button strength. Ingrid can combo in and out of the shooting stars for massive damage, and can also spend Sun Crests to launch even more projectiles. Finally, her Level 3 Super Art Cosmic Ray spawns a projectile on top of the opponent, letting her tack on even more damage at the end of her juggles. Though powerful, her Super Arts tend to be a bit on the slower side, making them risky to throw out in neutral. As with most of her kit, careful resource management is required to avoid being caught off guard.

While she may be comfortable from afar and at the mid range, Ingrid has a much less pleasant time up close. Without her Sun Crests, her damage potential is drastically cut down, and opponents capable of skipping through her fireball pressure through projectile-invulnerability or alternate angles can prevent her from building up her stocks, since her Sun Shots and even her Super Art 2 disappear if she gets hit. Ingrid also lacks a naturally plus-on-block normal, forcing her to either spend resources or delay her buttons to maintain advantage. Any careless stocks, haphazard fireballs, or blocked Super Arts can lead to massive punishes, especially against eagle-eyed opponents waiting for them. In order to enforce her domain, Ingrid has to keep the opponent guessing by alternating between teleports, fireballs, pokes, and her OD Counter to avoid being predictable. Only by invoking the fear of the Goddess can she unleash divine power.
Overall, if you like abnormal zoning patterns, can get into your opponent's head, and want to cash out with absurd damage, unleash the power of the sun with Ingrid!

pick.title: Spacial Oddities
pick.text: An array of projectiles that can be used concurrently, an anti-air with a uniquely easy input, and a full-screen beam all come together to make for a tricky zoning game.

pick.title: Cataclysmic Cutie
pick.text: Having HUGE burst damage when loaded up on system and character resources.

pick.title: Limbs of the Forbidden One
pick.text: Strong pokes and whiff punishes that lead into Target Combos and further damage.

avoid.title: Hey! No Fair!
avoid.text: Needing to rely on a zoning game.

avoid.title: God Complex
avoid.text: Managing a stock system to gain access to her full potential, and having to choose between Sun Crests and okizeme.

avoid.title: Depressurisation
avoid.text: Not sticking to your opponent in pressure.

moves.name: Sunburst Blow

moves.name: Sun Veil
moves.notes: Counter that can absorb strikes (resulting in a counter-attack) or dissipate 1-hit non-Super projectiles; counter-attack is a strike knockdown that can be blocked if triggered by a low-recovery attack; counter-attack has 12f startup / 3f active / 21f recovery / 45f total animation / 1-14 fully invuln / Armor Break / no collision box 1-14f (some moves can pass through before counter-attack connects); absorbing a projectile results in 28f total recovery (often punishable if done from longer ranges); can be used to counter most strike-based Supers (useful option out of Drive Rush cancel on reaction to opponent's Super freeze); Ingrid is in a counter-hit state on frames 1-5 and a Punish Counter state for the rest of the move's duration; extends a vulnerable arm hurtbox on frames 21-36 if the counter whiffs

moves.name: Sun Veil
moves.notes: Counter that can absorb strikes/throws (resulting in a counter-attack) or dissipate non-Super projectiles even with multiple hits; counter-attack is a strike knockdown that can be blocked if triggered by a safe jump (3f leniency on safe jump timing); counter-attack has 6f startup / 6f active / 21f recovery / 40f total animation / 1-11 fully invuln / Armor Break / no collision box 1-11f (some moves can pass through before counter-attack connects); after absorbing a projectile hit, Ingrid incurs up to 9f fully invincible recovery per hit (refreshing for each new hit absorbed) followed by 15f vulnerable recovery; can be used to counter most Supers (useful option out of Drive Rush cancel on reaction to opponent's Super freeze); extends a vulnerable arm hurtbox on frames 21-36 if the counter whiffs

moves.name: Sunburst Beam
moves.notes: Dark Ingrid only; tall 16-hit beam projectile that reaches fullscreen; expands forward during the first 4 active frames before reaching full range on the 5th active frame; most/all hits will connect even if opponent falls into the late active frames; chip damage deals 50% of its base damage rather than the usual 25%

moves.name: Shining Sun (0 Stock)
moves.notes: Can hold the button to spend up to 2 Sun Crests (+400 damage per crest but reduced oki); sends opponent ~1/2 screen away on hit; Ingrid's primary reversal while in Burnout (but slow startup makes it susceptible to safejab pressure); hitbox has a dead zone that can cause it to whiff through high airborne opponents; solid anti-air but cannot hit cross-up; 1st hit deals 400 damage and puts the opponent into a limited juggle state if it trades with a projectile (high float for easy hitconfirm)

moves.name: Shining Sun (1 Stock)
moves.notes: Hold the button for 30 frames to spend 1 Sun Crest for 400 extra damage and a farther knockdown; sends opponent ~2/3 screen away on hit; hitbox has a dead zone that can cause it to whiff through high airborne opponents; solid anti-air but cannot hit cross-up; 1st hit deals 400 damage and puts the opponent into a limited juggle state if it trades with a projectile (high float for easy hitconfirm)

moves.name: Shining Sun (2 Stock)
moves.notes: Hold the button for 60 frames to spend 2 Sun Crests for 800 extra damage and a farther knockdown; sends opponent a full screen away on hit; hitbox has a dead zone that can cause it to whiff through high airborne opponents; solid anti-air but cannot hit cross-up; 1st hit deals 400 damage and puts the opponent into a limited juggle state if it trades with a projectile (high float for easy hitconfirm)

moves.name: Cosmic Ray

moves.name: Cosmic Ray (CA)
moves.notes: Projectile hitbox that targets the opponent's position 8f before it becomes active (can continue moving slightly upward after this point); the opponent can avoid the projectile by moving quickly (like a fast Drive Rush or jumping after the Super freeze); available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~2.3 Drive bars for Ingrid; very slow startup makes it a poor reversal

moves.name: Sun Shot

moves.name: Sun Rise
moves.notes: 4 hits (only 3 hits on block/whiff); Low Crush 14-26f (not airborne); safe buffer option that becomes +1 vs. Burnout; forces stand on the first 3 hits; carries over Counter-Hit / Punish Counter bonus frame advantage through the first 3 hits (affects SA2 cancel advantage); SA2 cancel: +15/+5

moves.name: Sun Rise
moves.notes: Strong anti-air but cannot hit cross-up; deals 200 less damage and has reduced advantage (KD +32~38) on active frames 4-10

moves.notes: See Drive Impact. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

moves.name: Solar Burst (1 Stock)
moves.notes: 2-hit projectile hitbox; can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 13-37; Ingrid will land before the projectile comes out if activated on jump frame 30-37; consumes 1 Sun Crest for more hits, extra damage, and longer range compared to 0-stock MP/HP version; stock is consumed on frame 2; can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +40, on block becomes -10 vs. standing, -9 vs. crouching); puts opponents into a limited juggle state (corner follow-ups possible if input low to the ground); 2f extra landing recovery when performed from a neutral jump; Ingrid is in a crouching state on the final landing recovery frame; extends a large full-body hurtbox until Ingrid lands (lower body hurtbox is projectile invincible); hitbox is considered both a projectile and an airborne attack (loses to both types of invuln)

moves.name: Solar Burst (2 Stock)
moves.notes: 3-hit projectile hitbox; can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 13-37; Ingrid will land before the projectile comes out if activated on jump frame 30-37; consumes 2 Sun Crests for more hits, extra damage, and longer range compared to 1-stock HP version; stocks are consumed on frame 2 and the first active frame (only 1 stock is consumed if interrupted on startup or if Ingrid lands before active); can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +55, on block becomes -6 vs. standing, -5 vs. crouching); launches opponents upward into a limited juggle state; 3f extra landing recovery when performed from a neutral jump; Ingrid is in a crouching state on the final landing recovery frame; extends a large full-body hurtbox until Ingrid lands (lower body hurtbox is projectile invincible); hitbox is considered both a projectile and an airborne attack (loses to both types of invuln)

moves.name: Solar Burst
moves.notes: Can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 17-33; builds 1 Sun Crest on frame 47 (1f before end of recovery); the animation lasts 48f regardless of when it was input during the jump (more total recovery if input late in the jump arc); landing recovery ranges from 8-30f depending on activation time; Ingrid is in a counter-hit state for the entire duration and a Forced Knockdown state during all airborne frames; if performed with 4 Sun Crests, Ingrid builds 3000 Drive gauge instead; can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +10, on block becomes -32 and shifts backward); extends a large full-body hurtbox for the entire move duration; can be used after midscreen 236HK (earliest timing) to gain a stock while maintaining KD +5 oki after a forward dash

moves.name: Solar Burst
moves.notes: 1-hit projectile hitbox; can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 13-37; Ingrid will land before the projectile comes out if activated on jump frame 30-37; this version also comes out when input with HP button if Ingrid has 0 Sun Crests; can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +36, on block becomes -11 vs. standing, -10 vs. crouching); puts opponents into a limited juggle state (corner follow-ups possible if input low to the ground); 2f extra landing recovery when performed from a neutral jump; Ingrid is in a crouching state on the final landing recovery frame; extends a large full-body hurtbox until Ingrid lands (lower body hurtbox is projectile invincible); can be used after corner 236HK launch (earliest timing), allowing Ingrid to land and build another Sun Crest without losing corner oki; hitbox is considered both a projectile and an airborne attack (loses to both types of invuln)

moves.name: Solar Burst
moves.notes: 2-hit OD projectile hitbox; can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 13-37; Ingrid will land before the projectile comes out if activated on jump frame 30-37; has the properties of the 1-stock HP version without spending any Sun Crests; can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +40, on block becomes -10 vs. standing, -9 vs. crouching); puts opponents into a limited juggle state (corner follow-ups possible if input low to the ground); 2f extra landing recovery when performed from a neutral jump; Ingrid is in a crouching state on the final landing recovery frame; extends a large full-body hurtbox until Ingrid lands (lower body hurtbox is projectile invincible); hitbox is considered both a projectile and an airborne attack (loses to both types of invuln)

moves.name: Solar Burst (1 Stock)
moves.notes: 3-hit OD projectile hitbox; can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 13-37; Ingrid will land before the projectile comes out if activated on jump frame 30-37; has the properties of the 2-stock HP version but only costs 1 Sun Crest; stock is consumed on frame 2; can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +55, on block becomes -6 vs. standing, -5 vs. crouching); launches opponents upward into a limited juggle state; 3f extra landing recovery when performed from a neutral jump; Ingrid is in a crouching state on the final landing recovery frame; extends a large full-body hurtbox until Ingrid lands (lower body hurtbox is projectile invincible); hitbox is considered both a projectile and an airborne attack (loses to both types of invuln)

moves.name: Solar Burst (2 Stock)
moves.notes: 4-hit OD projectile hitbox; can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 13-37; Ingrid will land before the projectile comes out if activated on jump frame 30-37; has properties greater than the 2-stock HP version or 1-stock OD version for 2 Sun Crests; stocks are consumed on frame 2 and the first active frame (only 1 stock is consumed if interrupted on startup or if Ingrid lands before active); can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +66, on block becomes +1 vs. standing, +2 vs. crouching); puts opponents into a free juggle OTG bounce state; if the opponent Perfect Parries and Ingrid lands before all 4 hits connect, all remaining hits will fail to come out resulting in worse frame advantage; Ingrid is in a crouching state on the final landing recovery frame; extends a large full-body hurtbox until Ingrid lands (lower body hurtbox is projectile invincible); hitbox is considered both a projectile and an airborne attack (loses to both types of invuln)

moves.name: Jumping Heavy Kick
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (can juggle into Target Combo extension); lower body projectile invuln 12-19f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs); best horizontal range of Ingrid's jump-ins

moves.name: Satellite Leap
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; cannot hit grounded opponents (too slow to connect even after max-height j.HK); 1st hit pulls opponents inward (if the 2nd hit whiffs, opponent can fly over Ingrid for a side switch)

moves.name: Jumping Heavy Punch
moves.notes: Spikes airborne opponents on counter-hit/Punish Counter; has juggle potential (causes air reset when juggled after 236HK); lower body projectile invuln 9-23f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs); hitbox extends farther beyond Ingrid's arm (visually deceptive); best downward reach of Ingrid's jump-ins for vertical approaches

moves.name: Jumping Light Kick
moves.notes: Cross-up; good air-to-air for potential cross-ups (e.g. E. Honda Sumo Smash, M. Bison Devil Reverse)

moves.name: Jumping Light Punch
moves.notes: Fastest air-to-air; good hitbox priority

moves.name: Jumping Medium Kick
moves.notes: Cross-up; lower body projectile invuln 8-21f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Medium Punch
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; lower body projectile invuln 8-23f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Strange Knuckle
moves.notes: No true throw loop, but can dash to become +1 for a corner pseudo-throw loop (also in range for a 2-hit light confirm); can follow with Drive Rush normals like 5HK/2HP; can set up a LP Sun Shot that allows Ingrid to dash in with frame advantage while recovering quickly enough to anti-air if the opponent jumps out of the corner; can throw opponent into falling projectiles after SA2 activation (limited juggle state and the throw itself deals full damage); a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Monoid Super
moves.notes: Slow 3-bar Super with low damage relative to its meter cost; unsafe on hit or block; on hit, Ingrid returns and high-fives the Monoid (can transform into Dark Ingrid using the LP~LP~4~LK~HK input before the high five, becoming much more unsafe on hit); Modern Controls: 214236H

moves.name: Monoid Star Thrust
moves.notes: Requires summoning the Monoid with Ingrid's Back Taunt; can hold forward to steer and increase the attack's range; knocks down on grounded opponents and resets airborne opponents; Modern Controls: H

moves.name: Monoid Beam
moves.notes: Requires summoning the Monoid with Ingrid's Back Taunt; cannot steer the attack forward like the other Monoid attacks; knocks down on both grounded and airborne opponents; input has no kara-cancel leniency (must hit HP+HK on the exact same frame); Modern Controls: Sp

moves.name: Monoid Aerial Strike
moves.notes: Requires summoning the Monoid with Ingrid's Back Taunt; can hold forward to steer and increase the attack's range; knocks down on grounded opponents and resets airborne opponents; gains a second hitbox on active frames 3-6 that can hit cross-up; Modern Controls: j.X

moves.name: Monoid Low Dive
moves.notes: Requires summoning the Monoid with Ingrid's Back Taunt; 3 hits (all hit low despite the divekick-like animation); can hold forward to steer and increase the attack's range; Modern Controls: L

moves.name: Monoid Overhead Hammer
moves.notes: Requires summoning the Monoid with Ingrid's Back Taunt; can hold forward to steer and increase the attack's range; knocks down on grounded opponents and resets airborne opponents; Modern Controls: M

moves.name: Drive Parry
moves.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: Drive Rush Cancel
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: Parry Drive Rush
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.375 (min/throw), 1.502 (min/block), 3.083 (max/final DR frame)
